## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser-based 3D open-world survival game inspired by Icarus.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks at viewport width ≤1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-based low-poly survival expedition, “WILDLANDS — Last Light,” with gather/craft/survive/reach-the-beacon gameplay.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game interface, Three.js world, survival stats, gathering, crafting, wildlife, beacon objective, and desktop/mobile controls.
- Fixed malformed gradient syntax in `style.css`, which had caused subsequent CSS rules to be ignored.
- Wrapped the start overlay contents in `.notice-card` in `index.html`, fixing the overlay layout.
- Reloaded the game at 1280×800, confirmed CSS rules load and the start button is positioned onscreen, and saved/inspected `screenshots/latest.jpg`.
- Started the game; the HUD and gameplay interface render.

### Active
- Test gameplay interactions and runtime behavior in-browser; the initial gather-key test yielded no resources or interaction prompt.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Investigate why pressing `E` at the starting position does not gather resources; verify target detection and resource node positions.
2. Test movement, gathering, crafting, item use, and pause/resume; check game-specific console errors.
3. Fix issues found, then report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and overlays; start overlay structure was corrected.
- `style.css`: Responsive interface styling; malformed gradient declaration was corrected.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, gameplay systems, and input handling.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Latest start-screen screenshot at 1280×800.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Three.js is imported from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
- Objective flow: craft stone axe, place a campfire, reach the ridge beacon, activate it with the signal flare.
- Prior browser checks reported a missing `favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL readback performance warnings; no game-specific runtime errors were reported before the latest UI corrections.
